GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiTheme class.

GetColorScheme.description: Returns the color scheme of the current theme.

GetFontScheme.description: Returns the font scheme of the current theme.

GetFormatScheme.description: Returns the format scheme of the current theme.

GetMaster.description: Returns the slide master of the current theme.

returns.description: returns null if slide master doesn't exist.

SetColorScheme.description: Sets the color scheme to the current presentation theme.

returns.description: return false if color scheme doesn't exist.

SetFontScheme.description: Sets the font scheme to the current presentation theme.

returns.description: return false if font scheme doesn't exist.

SetFormatScheme.description: Sets the format scheme to the current presentation theme.

returns.description: return false if format scheme doesn't exist.
